description: This file defines the HistoryModalController class, which manages the behavior of a history modal in a web application. It handles opening, dismissing, and setting notes within the modal, and integrates with application services such as keyboard commands and event handling.

classes.name: HistoryModalController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the history modal, extending AbstractViewController.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, resetting the note to undefined.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with application, event bus, and notes controller references; sets up keyboard command handling.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the current note in the modal.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Opens the modal with a specified note.

methods.name: dismissModal
methods.description: Closes the modal by resetting the note to undefined.
